title: Storybound Codex entry
description: data/<namespace>/storybound/codex/<path>.json — an entry made of sections the player uncovers one by one.

icon.description: Dev mode only: the item this node shows on the editor's canvases (an item id, e.g. minecraft:compass). The game does not read it; without it, the kind's own item.

category.description: Group in the Codex tab; a missing namespace means storybound. Name: <ns>.codex.category.<path>. Built in: monsters, animals, characters, companions, structures, biomes, pois, places, lore.

entity.description: What seen and killed refer to: an id, a #tag or a list. A single id also gives the portrait.

place.description: What visited refers to: a structure, biome, point of interest, dimension, or area. When several are given, all must hold at once.

biome.description: In any of these biomes: an id, a #tag, or a list.

structure.description: Inside any of these structures: an id, a #tag, or a list.

poi.description: Near any of these points of interest: an id, a #tag, or a list.

radius.description: How close to the point of interest, in blocks.

area.description: Inside a specific area in the world.

image.description: Default illustration shown in a book frame at the top of the Codex page (overridden if the player captures their own photo): a story image from config/storybound/images/<namespace>/<name>.png or a full texture path.

photo.description: Whether the player can capture their own in-world screenshot for this Codex entry. Defaults to true when 'place' is set, false otherwise.

text.description: A long text, assets/<ns>/storybound/texts/<lang>/<path>.sbt. Default: <ns>:codex/<entry path>/<section id>.

notify.description: Toasts when the entry appears or a section opens.

show_kills.description: With an entity: count and show "Killed: N" in the Codex. Off for characters and peaceful creatures.

unlock.description: Any source reaching count (sightings or kills; a read, a study, or a visit counts once) opens the section, if the conditions hold then. observed:<seconds>: studied, looked straight at the creature that long. visited: the player entered the entry's place.
